project_scope.note: Built around local barberry morphology and a rights-cleared fruit reference.

family_diagnostics.where_to_look_first: For local Berberis, start with yellow inner wood/tissue, leathery spiny leaflets, and small yellow flowers.
family_diagnostics.flower: Multiple petaloid sepal whorls plus 6 nectar-bearing petals; 6 stamens opposite petals.
family_diagnostics.anthers: Berberis anthers open by apically hinged valves.
family_diagnostics.field_tip: The anther mechanism is powerful but not universal across the whole family.

visual_lesson.teaching_order: whole plant → high-value structure → reproductive confirmation → tie-breaker
visual_lesson.intro: Local barberries are a great lesson in using vegetative color plus flower mechanics, not just thorny shrub gestalt.

steps.title: 1 · Start with the prickly evergreen shrub
steps.look_for: Evergreen woody habit with compound leaves and stiff spine-tipped leaflet margins.
steps.why_it_matters: Sets the local barberry gestalt before flower details.

steps.title: 2 · Remember the yellow inner tissue
steps.look_for: Bright yellow inner wood or tissue on naturally exposed material.

steps.title: 3 · Read the flower in layers
steps.look_for: Petaloid sepals in multiple whorls, then 6 nectar-bearing petals and 6 stamens opposite them.
steps.why_it_matters: The flower is more complex than 'six tepals.'

steps.title: 4 · Follow to the berry
steps.look_for: Fleshy berry fruit on a spiny evergreen shrub.
steps.why_it_matters: Fruit closes the local Berberis family loop.

comparisons.title: Berberis vs Nandina
comparisons.rule: Both are Berberidaceae, but Berberis uses hinged-valve anthers while Nandina anthers open by longitudinal slits.

comparisons.title: Modern taxonomy
comparisons.rule: Older Mahonia names may now be treated within Berberis; avoid duplicate learner taxa.

visual_lesson.caveat: Do not make hinged-valve anthers universal for all Berberidaceae.

video_handoff.policy: Use exact video frames for family teaching now; do not convert either taxon into a canonical anchor until strict taxonomy/range review passes.
